results.snippet: When Kathará deploys a device D₂ inside D₁ (with Dᵢ being a device at depth i) running the kathara/nested image, D₂ bind-mounts the Docker image
results.title: internal, and the internal image itself. This solution allows a single level nesting similar to DinD, with the addition of the pre-loaded images that avoids to re-download them. In order to support multiple nesting levels without the same overheads described above, we modified Kathará as follows. When Kathará deploys a device D₂ inside D₁ (with Dᵢ being a device at depth i) running the kathara/nested image, D₂ bind-mounts the Docker image repository folder of D₁. This means that the Docker daemon inside D₂ can directly use the Docker images of D₁, including the internal image itself. Hence, each device Dₙ (with n > 2) that deploys a container with nested virtualization enabled, uses the internal image and bind-mounts the image repository folder of Dₙ₋₁. item.text:
Implementato il DNS interno gerarchico.

- Ruoli DNS passati a `kathara/bind`: `pc2`, `pc4`, `pc6`, `pc8`, `pc10`.
- Root interna su `pc2`, con delega e glue IPv6 per `test.`.
- `pc4` primario e `pc6` secondario tramite zone transfer.
- Delega `services.test.` a `pc8`.
- Resolver ricorsivo su `pc10`, con root hints interni e senza forwarder.
- `pc12` usa esclusivamente `2001:db8:1100:4::10` in `/etc/resolv.conf`.
- Record richiesti inclusi: `www` A/AAAA, `portal` CNAME, MX 10, `mail`/`status` AAAA e TXT.

Configurazioni principali: [root](./pc2/etc/bind/db.root), [test](./pc4/etc/bind/db.test), [services.test](./pc8/etc/bind/db.services.test), [resolver](./pc10/etc/bind/named.conf).

Verifica statica completata: `kathara lstart --print` conferma che `lab.conf` è valido. L’avvio effettivo non è eseguibile in questo ambiente perché il demone Docker non è accessibile.
